summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a periodic report on its ongoing share buyback program. The report details daily purchases under the second tranche of a multi-year €3.5 billion buyback announced during the 2025 Capital Markets Day, covering trades on Euronext Milan and NYSE from July 13–17, 2026. No special-situation event occurred; this is a routine disclosure of open-market repurchases as part of a capital return program. There are no M&A, activist, tender, or restructuring elements. The filing is purely informational. The buyback is a regular capital allocation activity, not a special situation.
